thread.title: The Quarter’s Five Best Dow Stocks: Intel, Cisco Sing

author: Teresa Rivas
title: The Quarter’s Five Best Dow Stocks: Intel, Cisco Sing
text:
Now that the first quarter is in the books, let's take a look back at the the best-performing stocks in the Dow .
Intel (INTC) gained 12.8%. The chip giant could be a beneficiary of Broadcom's (AVGO) failed bid for Qualcomm (QCOM), even if analysts aren't happy about the price tag of a potential Intel offer for Broadcom. Als0, Apple (AAPL) selling fewer pricier iPhones may mean the company could tap Intel and other cheaper suppliers . Intel's enterprise and memory businesses are also doing well, as evidenced by its upbeat quarter and dividend increase .
Cisco Systems (CSCO) gained 12%. The shares got a big boost last month from the networking giant's upbeat second-quarter earnings and increased capital-return program, and analysts are optimistic about its products.
Boeing (BA) gained 11.2%. Although the shares have been battered by trade-war worries lately, geopolitical instability boosted Boeing and its defense peers earlier in the year, and the shares have tripled since a February 2016 low through January, after notching the best performance in the Dow in 2017.
Microsoft (MSFT) gained 6.7%. While tech stocks have been clobbered lately, the software giant's enterprise and cloud businesses have been doing very well, leading some to say that it will eventually be able to join the trillion-dollar club with other big tech stars. Just this week we got a management shakeup as the company focuses on " edge computing ."
Nike (NKE) gained 6.2%. Shares of the apparel maker rose after reporting earnings last week, and while some are worried about Nike being hurt in a trade war , plenty of analysts are still bullish , thanks to missteps by rivals , popularity with millennials , and a shakeup in the C-suite .
